serviceOutput: Past & Present Self-Authoring Integration: Systematically resolving historical career bottlenecks, analyzing personal strengths and faults, and setting definitive baseline trajectories.
Ideal Future vs. Hell to Avoid Architecture: Crafting detailed 3-to-5 year positive vision roadmaps coupled with visceral negative avoidance scenarios to maintain peak daily motivation.
7 Habits Operating Cadence: Implementing Covey's Circle of Influence, Quadrant II prioritization, personal mission statements, and weekly 'Sharpen the Saw' renewal protocols.
Private AI Socratic Coaching Vault: Setting up local markdown journaling in Obsidian with private AI agents acting as neutral, confidential accountability partners.
Milestone & Habit Execution Engine: Transforming macro principles into daily micro-habits, tracking metrics, and weekly reflective review loops.
